hook_text: This multiplug melted. Can you spot why before it happens in your home?
clip_script: An electrician visits Tembisa with a box of danger: a melted multiplug, a cord worn through, a tangle of illegal wire. Mains electricity can shock, burn and kill. So: dry hands only. Never poke a fork into a toaster. Do not overload multiplugs. Outside: never climb pylons, never fly kites near lines, and never touch a loose wire. If someone is getting a shock, do not grab them. Switch off the power first.
visual_style: Whiteboard house and street with danger spots circled in red, each one ticked as it is made safe.
mood: Serious and protective, like a safety mission.
pacing: Box of danger, home hunt with four rules, street hunt with three rules, then the rescue rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and do a safety hunt at home with an adult.
